manifestations.name: Pesan tidak tersampaikan
manifestations.entry_method: Tulis message contract; periksa urutan informasi, hold, edit dan viewer comprehension.

manifestations.name: Identitas terasa generik
manifestations.entry_method: Bangun visual grammar serta motion grammar dari tujuan; nilai consistency dan distinction.

manifestations.name: Teks bergerak tetapi sulit dibaca
manifestations.entry_method: Pisahkan reveal dari reading window; inspect shaping, size, contrast dan exposure.

manifestations.name: Gerak terasa mekanis atau tanpa berat
manifestations.entry_method: Periksa velocity/acceleration, pivot, deformation, response lag serta contact.

manifestations.name: Ruang tidak terasa dalam
manifestations.entry_method: Uji projection, occlusion, parallax, light/shadow dan compositing cues.

manifestations.name: Morph robek atau twist
manifestations.entry_method: Periksa correspondence, winding, topology dan edge sampling.

manifestations.name: Transisi terasa ditempel
manifestations.entry_method: Nyatakan fungsi perubahan konteks; compare match, cut dan motivated occlusion.

manifestations.name: Efek flicker atau terlalu ramai
manifestations.entry_method: Pisahkan signal variation dari aliasing; batasi frequencies, hierarchy dan history.

manifestations.name: Tepi transparan gelap
manifestations.entry_method: Uji premultiplication, filtering space dan output alpha support.

manifestations.name: Suara tidak mengikuti impact
manifestations.entry_method: Gunakan single cue timebase; decode dan ukur onset/duration serta listening.

manifestations.name: Video bagus di preview tapi rusak setelah ekspor
manifestations.entry_method: Check actual codec, chroma, color transform/tags, timebase serta decoded pixels.

manifestations.name: Video tidak nyaman ditonton
manifestations.entry_method: Nilai whole-field movement, flash patterns, information load dan viewing conditions.
